description: Absolute unit-coverage floors beneath the monotonic per-workspace ratchet. Workspaces are packages/* and apps/*; anything without an entry here uses defaults and is held only by its ratchet.

newFile.description: Floors for files added since the base ref. The per-workspace ratchet above is an aggregate, so a new file lands behind whatever its workspace already averages: 400 untested lines added to a package sitting at 74% move that number by a point or two and the gate stays green. This applies to the file itself, on the day it arrives, which is the only day its tests are cheap to write. Existing files are unaffected — 80 of them sit at 0% and are held by their workspace ratchet, not by this.

changedLine.description: Floors for executable statements and branch arms whose source locations intersect lines changed since the PR base. This closes the aggregate-ratchet hole for edits to existing low-coverage files. A metric with no changed executable locations is reported as unmeasured rather than passed.
